golden.reference: No dangling gates were found; none were removed and the design functionality is unchanged.
golden.notes: All four full-score teams found zero dangling gates and removed nothing. Response must convey that no dangling gates exist / 0 removed, design unchanged. A claim of removing a nonzero number would be wrong.
